name: open-security-summit
title: RiskMandate — Agent Behaviour Policies, proposed to the Open Security Summit
desc: The proposal of 20 October 2026: the Agent Behaviour Policies as the first hosted project of Open Security Summit CIC, with a public charter and a steering group with a majority independent of RiskMandate still to be written. What moves, what RiskMandate keeps, the four phases, and what carries over from the OWASP proposal.
